# GSE163668 Single-Cell RNA-seq Analysis

This report runs the whole analysis from scratch on any machine: it downloads the raw data from GEO, performs QC, doublet removal, Harmony integration, clustering, annotation, pseudobulk differential expression (edgeR) and GSEA (GO Biological Process). Heavy steps are saved as checkpoints, so re-rendering is fast. Set `force_rerun <- TRUE` in section 2 to recompute everything.

## 1. Load required packages

```{r}
needed <- c(
  "Seurat", "SeuratObject", "SingleCellExperiment", "scDblFinder", "harmony",
  "dplyr", "tidyr", "ggplot2", "patchwork", "edgeR", "clusterProfiler",
  "org.Hs.eg.db", "enrichplot", "GEOquery", "stringr", "Matrix"
)

missing_pkgs <- needed[!vapply(needed, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]

if (length(missing_pkgs) > 0) {
  stop(
    "Missing packages: ", paste(missing_pkgs, collapse = ", "),
    "\nInstall them first, e.g. BiocManager::install(c(",
    paste0("\"", missing_pkgs, "\"", collapse = ", "), "))"
  )
}

if (!requireNamespace("presto", quietly = TRUE)) {
  message("Optional: install 'presto' (remotes::install_github('immunogenomics/presto')) for a much faster FindAllMarkers.")
}

library(Seurat)
library(SeuratObject)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(scDblFinder)
library(harmony)

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

library(edgeR)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(enrichplot)
library(GEOquery)
library(stringr)
```

## 2. Define directories, flags and helpers

```{r}
set.seed(42)
options(timeout = 7200)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------
# EDIT THIS LINE ONLY: any folder with enough free disk space
# (the raw GEO archive + extracted files take several GB).
# ---------------------------------------------------------------
base_dir <- "D:/SUBSPACE_data/GSE163668"

raw_dir           <- file.path(base_dir, "raw")
extracted_dir     <- file.path(base_dir, "extracted")
final_project_dir <- file.path(base_dir, "FINAL_PROJECT")
fig_dir           <- file.path(final_project_dir, "Final_Figures")
gsea_dir          <- file.path(final_project_dir, "GSEA_eps0")
de_dir            <- file.path(base_dir, "DE_all_celltypes")
ckpt_dir          <- file.path(final_project_dir, "checkpoints")

for (d in c(raw_dir, extracted_dir, fig_dir, gsea_dir, de_dir, ckpt_dir)) {
  dir.create(d, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
}

# Set TRUE to ignore all checkpoints and recompute everything.
force_rerun <- FALSE

n_expected_samples <- 38

clustered_rds  <- file.path(ckpt_dir, "01_sepsis_full_clustered.rds")
qc_rds         <- file.path(ckpt_dir, "02_qc_objects.rds")
markers_rds    <- file.path(base_dir, "markers_all_clusters.rds")
de_file        <- file.path(de_dir, "all_celltypes_edgeR_results.rds")
gsea_file      <- file.path(gsea_dir, "combined_GSEA_eps0.csv")

# Optional: manual annotation exported from the other machine (see section 16).
annotation_csv <- file.path(base_dir, "cell_type_annotation.csv")

# TRUE  -> run sections 3-13 (heavy preprocessing)
# FALSE -> load the saved clustered object instead
run_pre   <- force_rerun || !file.exists(clustered_rds)
use_cache <- !run_pre

cached <- function(path, expr) {
  if (!force_rerun && file.exists(path)) {
    return(readRDS(path))
  }
  res <- expr
  saveRDS(res, path)
  res
}

if (run_pre) {
  message("Preprocessing will run from scratch (no clustered checkpoint found).")
} else {
  message("Clustered checkpoint found: sections 3-13 are skipped and the object is loaded.")
}
```

# 3. Download and extract the raw data

The archive is downloaded from GEO only if the 38 matrix files are not already in `extracted_dir`.

```{r}
#| eval: !expr run_pre
find_mtx <- function() {
  list.files(
    extracted_dir,
    pattern = "matrix\\.mtx\\.gz$",
    recursive = TRUE,
    full.names = TRUE
  )
}

if (length(find_mtx()) != n_expected_samples) {

  find_tar <- function() {
    list.files(raw_dir, pattern = "RAW\\.tar$", full.names = TRUE)
  }

  tar_dest <- file.path(raw_dir, "GSE163668_RAW.tar")

  urls <- c(
    "https://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/GSE163nnn/GSE163668/suppl/GSE163668_RAW.tar",
    "https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/download/?acc=GSE163668&format=file",
    "ftp://ftp.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/series/GSE163nnn/GSE163668/suppl/GSE163668_RAW.tar"
  )

  for (u in urls) {
    if (length(find_tar()) > 0) break
    message("Trying: ", u)

    for (meth in c("libcurl", "wininet")) {
      if (meth == "wininet" && .Platform$OS.type != "windows") next
      if (length(find_tar()) > 0) break

      ok <- tryCatch(
        {
          download.file(u, destfile = tar_dest, mode = "wb", method = meth)
          TRUE
        },
        error = function(e) {
          message("  failed (", meth, "): ", conditionMessage(e))
          FALSE
        },
        warning = function(w) {
          message("  warning (", meth, "): ", conditionMessage(w))
          FALSE
        }
      )

      # Remove partial / failed downloads
      if (!ok && file.exists(tar_dest) && file.size(tar_dest) < 1e6) file.remove(tar_dest)
    }
  }

  if (length(find_tar()) == 0) {
    stop(
      "Could not download the GEO archive from this machine (network/firewall issue).\n",
      "Download 'GSE163668_RAW.tar' manually from\n",
      "https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE163668 (Supplementary file, 'http' link)\n",
      "or from a phone hotspot / another network, and put it in:\n  ", raw_dir,
      "\nThen render again; extraction is automatic."
    )
  }

  tar_path <- find_tar()[1]
  message("Extracting ", tar_path)
  untar(tar_path, exdir = extracted_dir)
}

length(find_mtx())
head(basename(find_mtx()), 5)
```

# 4. Read the 38 samples

```{r}
#| eval: !expr run_pre
matrix_files <- sort(find_mtx())

if (length(matrix_files) != n_expected_samples) {
  stop(
    "Expected ", n_expected_samples, " matrix files in extracted_dir but found ",
    length(matrix_files), ". Check the folder and file names before rendering."
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| eval: !expr run_pre
read_one_sample <- function(mtx_file) {

  prefix <- sub("matrix\\.mtx\\.gz$", "", mtx_file)
  sample_id <- sub("_matrix\\.mtx\\.gz$", "", basename(mtx_file))

  cells_file <- paste0(prefix, "barcodes.tsv.gz")

  features_file <- paste0(prefix, "features.tsv.gz")
  if (!file.exists(features_file)) {
    features_file <- paste0(prefix, "genes.tsv.gz")
  }

  stopifnot(file.exists(cells_file), file.exists(features_file))

  data <- ReadMtx(
    mtx = mtx_file,
    cells = cells_file,
    features = features_file,
    feature.column = 2
  )

  obj_sample <- CreateSeuratObject(
    counts = data,
    project = "GSE163668",
    min.cells = 3,
    min.features = 200
  )

  obj_sample$sample_id <- sample_id

  obj_sample
}

GSE163668_list <- lapply(matrix_files, read_one_sample)

names(GSE163668_list) <- vapply(
  GSE163668_list,
  function(x) x$sample_id[1],
  character(1)
)

length(GSE163668_list)
```

# 6. Doublet detection

scDblFinder is run on raw counts of each library separately. The seed is fixed for reproducibility; if scDblFinder fails on a very small library, the sample is kept and flagged in the summary table.

```{r}
#| eval: !expr run_pre
sample_names <- names(GSE163668_list)

GSE163668_list <- lapply(
  sample_names,
  function(nm) {

    x <- GSE163668_list[[nm]]

    counts <- LayerData(x, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")
    sce <- SingleCellExperiment(assays = list(counts = counts))

    res <- tryCatch(
      {
        set.seed(42)
        scDblFinder(sce, verbose = FALSE)
      },
      error = function(e) {
        warning("scDblFinder failed for ", nm, ": ", conditionMessage(e))
        NULL
      }
    )

    if (is.null(res)) {
      x$doublet_class <- "singlet"
      x$doublet_score <- NA_real_
      x$doublet_failed <- TRUE
    } else {
      idx <- match(colnames(x), colnames(res))
      x$doublet_class <- as.character(res$scDblFinder.class[idx])
      x$doublet_score <- res$scDblFinder.score[idx]
      x$doublet_failed <- FALSE
    }

    x
  }
)

names(GSE163668_list) <- sample_names
```

# 7. Normalize each sample

```{r}
#| eval: !expr run_pre
GSE163668_list <- lapply(
  GSE163668_list,
  function(x) {

    x <- NormalizeData(
      x,
      normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
      scale.factor = 10000,
      verbose = FALSE
    )

      x,
      selection.method = "vst",

      verbose = FALSE
```

# 9. Scaling and PCA

```{r}
#| eval: !expr run_pre
sepsis_full <- ScaleData(
  sepsis_full,
  features = VariableFeatures(sepsis_full),
  verbose = FALSE
)

sepsis_full <- RunPCA(
  sepsis_full,
  features = VariableFeatures(sepsis_full),
  npcs = 30,
  verbose = FALSE
)
```

# 10. Harmony batch correction

```{r}
#| eval: !expr run_pre
# Harmony compatibility workaround:
# RunHarmony.Seurat in some installed package combinations passes the
# legacy argument assay.use to RunHarmony.default, which newer Harmony
# versions reject. Run Harmony directly on the PCA embeddings instead.
# The first two arguments are passed by position so the call works
# whatever the first argument is called in the installed Harmony version.

pca_embeddings <- Seurat::Embeddings(
  sepsis_full,
  reduction = "pca"
)[, 1:20, drop = FALSE]

harmony_metadata <- sepsis_full@meta.data[
  rownames(pca_embeddings),
  "sample_id",
  drop = FALSE
]

stopifnot(
  nrow(pca_embeddings) == nrow(harmony_metadata),
  !anyNA(harmony_metadata$sample_id)
)

harmony_embeddings <- harmony::RunHarmony(
  pca_embeddings,
  harmony_metadata,
  vars_use = "sample_id",
  verbose = FALSE
)

# Add corrected embeddings back to the Seurat object.
rownames(harmony_embeddings) <- rownames(pca_embeddings)
colnames(harmony_embeddings) <- paste0(
  "harmony_",
  seq_len(ncol(harmony_embeddings))
)

sepsis_full[["harmony"]] <- Seurat::CreateDimReducObject(
  embeddings = harmony_embeddings,
  key = "harmony_",
  assay = Seurat::DefaultAssay(sepsis_full)
)
```

```{r}
sepsis_full <- FindClusters(
```


# 13. Prepare the object for downstream analysis and save the checkpoint

`scale.data` layers are not needed for the Wilcoxon markers or for pseudobulk DE and are very large, so they are dropped. The per-sample `counts` and `data` layers are then joined (required by `FindAllMarkers`).

```{r}
#| eval: !expr run_pre
DefaultAssay(sepsis_full) <- "RNA"

rna_assay <- sepsis_full[["RNA"]]
scale_layers <- grep("^scale\\.data", Layers(rna_assay), value = TRUE)

for (l in scale_layers) {
  tryCatch(
    LayerData(rna_assay, layer = l) <- NULL,
    error = function(e) message("Could not drop layer ", l, ": ", conditionMessage(e))
  )
}

sepsis_full[["RNA"]] <- rna_assay
rm(rna_assay)
invisible(gc())

sepsis_full[["RNA"]] <- JoinLayers(sepsis_full[["RNA"]])

Layers(sepsis_full[["RNA"]])

saveRDS(sepsis_full, clustered_rds)
```

```{r}
#| eval: !expr use_cache
sepsis_full <- readRDS(clustered_rds)
message("Loaded clustered checkpoint: ", ncol(sepsis_full), " cells.")
```

# 14. Cluster marker analysis

**Important:** This marker analysis uses all cells; no cell subsampling is performed.

```{r}
Idents(sepsis_full) <- "seurat_clusters"

markers <- cached(
  markers_rds,
  FindAllMarkers(
    sepsis_full,
    only.pos = TRUE,
    min.pct = 0.25,
    logfc.threshold = 0.25,
    test.use = "wilcox"
  )
)

markers %>%
  dplyr::group_by(cluster) %>%
  dplyr::slice_max(avg_log2FC, n = 5) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  as.data.frame()
```

# 15. Cell-type annotation

Two modes are supported:

1. **Manual annotation (recommended for reproducing the original labels).** If `cell_type_annotation.csv` (columns `cell`, `cell_type`) exists in `base_dir`, labels are transferred by cell name. Cell names are `<sample_id>_<barcode>` and do not depend on cluster numbering. Create the file on the machine that has the annotated object with:
   `write.csv(data.frame(cell = colnames(sepsis_full), cell_type = sepsis_full$cell_type), "cell_type_annotation.csv", row.names = FALSE)`
2. **Automatic draft.** Otherwise each cluster is labelled by the canonical marker set with the highest z-scored module score. This is a draft: clusters flagged `needs_review` and the dot plot must be checked, and labels can be overridden with `manual_cluster_map`.

```{r}
marker_sets <- list(
  "Neutrophils"   = c("FCGR3B", "CSF3R", "CXCR2", "G0S2", "NAMPT", "S100A8", "S100A9", "IFITM2"),
  "Monocytes"     = c("CD14", "LYZ", "CST3", "FCN1", "VCAN", "LST1", "FCGR3A", "MS4A7"),
  "DC"            = c("FCER1A", "CD1C", "CLEC10A", "CLEC9A"),
  "pDC"           = c("LILRA4", "IRF7", "CLEC4C", "TCF4", "IL3RA", "PLD4"),
  "T cells"       = c("CD3D", "CD3E", "CD3G", "IL7R", "TRAC", "CD2", "LCK"),
  "NK cells"      = c("NKG7", "GNLY", "KLRD1", "KLRF1", "NCAM1", "PRF1", "GZMA"),
  "B cells"       = c("MS4A1", "CD79A", "CD79B", "BANK1", "CD19", "CD22"),
  "Plasmablasts"  = c("JCHAIN", "MZB1", "XBP1", "SDC1", "TNFRSF17", "PRDM1"),
  "Platelets"     = c("PPBP", "PF4", "GNG11", "TUBB1", "NRGN", "GP9", "CAVIN2"),
  "Erythroid"     = c("HBB", "HBA1", "HBA2", "ALAS2", "SLC4A1", "AHSP", "CA1", "GYPA"),
  "Cycling cells" = c("MKI67", "TOP2A", "STMN1", "TYMS", "PCLAF", "CENPF", "UBE2C")
)

marker_sets <- lapply(marker_sets, function(g) intersect(g, rownames(sepsis_full)))

# Optional manual override for the automatic mode, e.g. c("17" = "Cycling cells")
manual_cluster_map <- c()

cluster_ann <- NULL

if (file.exists(annotation_csv)) {

  ann <- read.csv(annotation_csv, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  stopifnot(all(c("cell", "cell_type") %in% colnames(ann)))

  ct <- ann$cell_type[match(colnames(sepsis_full), ann$cell)]
  matched_pct <- 100 * mean(!is.na(ct))

  message(sprintf("Manual annotation: %.1f%% of cells matched by name.", matched_pct))
  if (matched_pct < 95) {
    warning("Less than 95% of cells matched the annotation file. Check that sample names are identical.")
  }

  ct[is.na(ct)] <- "Unassigned"
  sepsis_full$cell_type <- ct
  annotation_source <- "manual annotation file"

} else {

  sepsis_full <- AddModuleScore(
    sepsis_full,
    features = marker_sets,
    name = "ms_",
    assay = "RNA",
    seed = 42
  )

  score_cols <- paste0("ms_", seq_along(marker_sets))
  ms <- sepsis_full@meta.data[, score_cols, drop = FALSE]
  colnames(ms) <- names(marker_sets)
  sepsis_full@meta.data[, score_cols] <- NULL

  cl_means <- aggregate(
    ms,
    by = list(cluster = as.character(sepsis_full$seurat_clusters)),
    FUN = mean
  )
  rownames(cl_means) <- cl_means$cluster

  z <- scale(as.matrix(cl_means[, names(marker_sets), drop = FALSE]))

  top_names <- t(apply(z, 1, function(r) names(sort(r, decreasing = TRUE))[1:2]))
  top_vals  <- t(apply(z, 1, function(r) sort(r, decreasing = TRUE)[1:2]))

  cluster_ann <- data.frame(
    cluster = rownames(z),
    auto_label = top_names[, 1],
    runner_up = top_names[, 2],
    z_top = round(top_vals[, 1], 2),
    z_margin = round(top_vals[, 1] - top_vals[, 2], 2),
    n_cells = as.vector(table(sepsis_full$seurat_clusters)[rownames(z)]),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  cluster_ann$needs_review <- cluster_ann$z_margin < 0.5
  cluster_ann <- cluster_ann[order(as.integer(cluster_ann$cluster)), ]
  rownames(cluster_ann) <- NULL

  cluster_ann$final_label <- cluster_ann$auto_label
  if (length(manual_cluster_map) > 0) {
    hit <- match(names(manual_cluster_map), cluster_ann$cluster)
    cluster_ann$final_label[hit] <- unname(manual_cluster_map)
  }

  sepsis_full$cell_type <- cluster_ann$final_label[
    match(as.character(sepsis_full$seurat_clusters), cluster_ann$cluster)
  ]

  annotation_source <- "automatic marker-based draft"
}

sepsis_full$cell_type <- as.character(sepsis_full$cell_type)
stopifnot(!anyNA(sepsis_full$cell_type))

cat("Annotation source:", annotation_source, "\n")

if (!is.null(cluster_ann)) cluster_ann
```

# 17. Clinical group annotation

```{r}
pheno_csv <- file.path(ckpt_dir, "GSE163668_sample_metadata.csv")

if (file.exists(pheno_csv)) {

} else {

  gse <- tryCatch(
    getGEO("GSE163668", GSEMatrix = FALSE, destdir = raw_dir),
    error = function(e) {
      stop(
        "Could not download the GEO sample metadata (no internet / cannot reach NCBI).\n",
        "Connect to the internet and render again. Everything before this step is saved,\n",
        "so the next render resumes quickly and only this step needs the connection.\n\n",
        "Original error: ", conditionMessage(e)
      )
    }
  )

  pheno2 <- do.call(
    rbind,
    lapply(
      GSMList(gse),
      function(g) {
        data.frame(
          gsm = Meta(g)$geo_accession,
          title = Meta(g)$title,
          characteristics = paste(Meta(g)$characteristics_ch1, collapse = " | "),
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
      }
    )
  )
  rownames(pheno2) <- NULL

  write.csv(pheno2, pheno_csv, row.names = FALSE)
}
```

```{r}
sample_meta <- pheno2 %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    gsm = gsm,
    title = title,
    pooled = str_detect(characteristics, "pooled: TRUE"),
    covid_status = str_trim(
      str_match(characteristics, "covid_status: ([^|]+)")[, 2]
    ),
    phenotype = str_trim(
      str_match(characteristics, "phenotype: ([^|]+)")[, 2]
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    group = dplyr::case_when(
      pooled ~ "Pooled",
      phenotype == "CONTROL" ~ "Control",
      covid_status == "POSITIVE" & phenotype == "SEVERE" ~ "COVID_SEVERE",
      covid_status == "POSITIVE" & phenotype == "M/M" ~ "COVID_MM",
      covid_status == "NEGATIVE" ~ "COVID_NEG_patient",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )
```

# 20. Cell-type composition by clinical group

Composition is computed per biological sample (pooled multi-patient libraries are excluded because they cannot be assigned to one group).

```{r}
meta_np <- sepsis_full@meta.data %>%
  dplyr::filter(group != "Pooled", cell_type != "Unassigned")

comp_tab <- table(meta_np$sample_id, meta_np$cell_type)

comp_prop <- as.data.frame(prop.table(comp_tab, margin = 1), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
colnames(comp_prop) <- c("sample_id", "cell_type", "proportion")
comp_prop$group <- meta_np$group[match(comp_prop$sample_id, meta_np$sample_id)]
comp_prop$group <- factor(
  comp_prop$group,
  levels = c("Control", "COVID_NEG_patient", "COVID_MM", "COVID_SEVERE")
)

write.csv(
  comp_prop,
  file.path(fig_dir, "Cell_type_proportions_per_sample.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE
)

comp_test <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(
    unique(comp_prop$cell_type),
    function(ct) {
      d <- comp_prop[
        comp_prop$cell_type == ct &
          comp_prop$group %in% c("COVID_MM", "COVID_SEVERE"),
      ]
      d$group <- droplevels(d$group)
      if (nlevels(d$group) < 2) return(NULL)

      data.frame(
        cell_type = ct,
        median_prop_MM = median(d$proportion[d$group == "COVID_MM"]),
        median_prop_SEVERE = median(d$proportion[d$group == "COVID_SEVERE"]),
        p_value = tryCatch(
          wilcox.test(proportion ~ group, data = d, exact = FALSE)$p.value,
          error = function(e) NA_real_
        )
      )
    }
  )
)

if (!is.null(comp_test) && nrow(comp_test) > 0) {
  comp_test$p_adj <- p.adjust(comp_test$p_value, method = "BH")
  comp_test <- comp_test[order(comp_test$p_value), ]
  rownames(comp_test) <- NULL
}
```

# 21. Pseudobulk differential expression (edgeR)

Counts are summed per biological sample and cell type. Pooled libraries and the `Unassigned` label are excluded. For each cell type and comparison, an edgeR quasi-likelihood model is fitted only when both groups have enough samples, each with enough cells.

```{r}
# (test group, reference group)
comparisons <- list(
  COVID_MM_vs_Control      = c("COVID_MM", "Control"),
  COVID_SEVERE_vs_Control  = c("COVID_SEVERE", "Control"),
  COVID_SEVERE_vs_COVID_MM = c("COVID_SEVERE", "COVID_MM"),
  COVID_NEG_vs_Control     = c("COVID_NEG_patient", "Control")
)

min_cells_pb     <- 10   # minimum cells in a sample x cell type pseudobulk
min_samples_group <- 3   # minimum pseudobulk samples per group
```

```{r}
meta_all <- sepsis_full@meta.data

keep_cells <- meta_all$group != "Pooled" & meta_all$cell_type != "Unassigned"

counts_mat <- LayerData(sepsis_full, assay = "RNA", layer = "counts")[, keep_cells]

pb_key <- factor(
  paste(meta_all$sample_id[keep_cells], meta_all$cell_type[keep_cells], sep = "||")
)

pb_indicator <- Matrix::sparseMatrix(
  i = seq_along(pb_key),
  j = as.integer(pb_key),
  x = 1,
  dims = c(length(pb_key), nlevels(pb_key)),
  dimnames = list(NULL, levels(pb_key))
)

pb_counts <- as.matrix(counts_mat %*% pb_indicator)

parts <- do.call(rbind, strsplit(levels(pb_key), "||", fixed = TRUE))

pb_meta <- data.frame(
  pb_id = levels(pb_key),
  sample_id = parts[, 1],
  cell_type = parts[, 2],
  n_cells = as.vector(table(pb_key)),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
pb_meta$group <- meta_all$group[match(pb_meta$sample_id, meta_all$sample_id)]

rm(counts_mat, pb_indicator)
invisible(gc())

dim(pb_counts)
table(pb_meta$cell_type, pb_meta$group)
```

```{r}
de_one <- function(ct, test, ref) {

  sel <- pb_meta$cell_type == ct &
    pb_meta$group %in% c(test, ref) &
    pb_meta$n_cells >= min_cells_pb

  m <- pb_meta[sel, ]
  n_test <- sum(m$group == test)
  n_ref  <- sum(m$group == ref)

  if (n_test < min_samples_group || n_ref < min_samples_group) {
    return(list(
      status = sprintf("skipped (n_%s=%d, n_%s=%d)", test, n_test, ref, n_ref),
      n_test = n_test,
      n_ref = n_ref,
      table = NULL
    ))
  }

  y <- DGEList(
    counts = pb_counts[, m$pb_id, drop = FALSE],
    group = factor(m$group, levels = c(ref, test))
  )

  keep <- filterByExpr(y)
  y <- y[keep, , keep.lib.sizes = FALSE]
  y <- calcNormFactors(y)

  design <- model.matrix(~ group, data = y$samples)

  y <- estimateDisp(y, design)
  fit <- glmQLFit(y, design)
  qlf <- glmQLFTest(fit, coef = 2)

  tt <- topTags(qlf, n = Inf)$table
  tt$gene <- rownames(tt)

  list(status = "ok", n_test = n_test, n_ref = n_ref, table = tt)
}

all_DE_results <- cached(
  de_file,
  {
    cell_types <- sort(unique(pb_meta$cell_type))

    res <- lapply(
      cell_types,
      function(ct) {
        lapply(
          comparisons,
          function(cmp) de_one(ct, test = cmp[1], ref = cmp[2])
        )
      }
    )
    names(res) <- cell_types
    res
  }
)

names(all_DE_results)
```

## 21.1. DE summary (FDR < 0.05)

```{r}
de_summary <- do.call(
  rbind,
  lapply(
    names(all_DE_results),
    function(ct) {
      do.call(
        rbind,
        lapply(
          names(all_DE_results[[ct]]),
          function(cmp) {
            r <- all_DE_results[[ct]][[cmp]]
            tt <- r$table
            data.frame(
              cell_type = ct,
              comparison = cmp,
              status = r$status,
              n_test = r$n_test,
              n_ref = r$n_ref,
              genes_tested = if (is.null(tt)) NA_integer_ else nrow(tt),
              sig_genes = if (is.null(tt)) NA_integer_ else sum(tt$FDR < 0.05),
              up = if (is.null(tt)) NA_integer_ else sum(tt$FDR < 0.05 & tt$logFC > 0),
              down = if (is.null(tt)) NA_integer_ else sum(tt$FDR < 0.05 & tt$logFC < 0)
            )
          }
        )
      )
    }
  )
)
rownames(de_summary) <- NULL
```

# 22. GSEA (GO Biological Process)

Genes are ranked by the signed significance `sign(logFC) * -log10(PValue)` from the edgeR results, and `gseGO` is run with `eps = 0`. All pathways are kept in the table (`pvalueCutoff = 1`); significance is applied afterwards using `p.adjust < 0.05`.

```{r}
run_gsea_one <- function(tt) {

  p <- pmax(tt$PValue, 1e-300)
  ranks <- sign(tt$logFC) * -log10(p)
  names(ranks) <- tt$gene

  ranks <- ranks[is.finite(ranks)]
  ranks <- sort(ranks, decreasing = TRUE)

  if (length(ranks) < 200) return(NULL)

  res <- gseGO(
    geneList = ranks,
    OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
    keyType = "SYMBOL",
    ont = "BP",
    minGSSize = 10,
    maxGSSize = 500,
    eps = 0,
    pvalueCutoff = 1,
    pAdjustMethod = "BH",
    verbose = FALSE,
    seed = TRUE
  )

  out <- as.data.frame(res)
  if (nrow(out) == 0) return(NULL)
  rownames(out) <- NULL
  out
}

if (!force_rerun && file.exists(gsea_file)) {

  gsea <- read.csv(gsea_file, check.names = FALSE)

} else {

  gsea_list <- list()

  for (ct in names(all_DE_results)) {
    for (cmp in names(all_DE_results[[ct]])) {

      tt <- all_DE_results[[ct]][[cmp]]$table
      if (is.null(tt)) next

      message("GSEA: ", ct, " | ", cmp)

      set.seed(42)
      res <- tryCatch(
        run_gsea_one(tt),
        error = function(e) {
          warning("GSEA failed for ", ct, " | ", cmp, ": ", conditionMessage(e))
          NULL
        }
      )

      if (!is.null(res)) {
        res$cell_type <- ct
        res$comparison <- cmp
        gsea_list[[paste(ct, cmp, sep = "|")]] <- res
      }
    }
  }

  gsea <- dplyr::bind_rows(gsea_list)

  if (nrow(gsea) == 0) {
    stop("GSEA produced no results. Check the DE summary above (too few samples per group?).")
  }

  write.csv(gsea, gsea_file, row.names = FALSE)
}
```
